FLASHCARD · ALPHABET A–Z · AGES 3–4 YEARS

House Flashcard — Letter H for Preschoolers

A cosy house for the letter H. Your child lives in one, visits others and builds them out of blocks — which makes this one of the most-rehearsed words in a preschooler’s day already.

← GrapesPrevious cardIce cream →Next card

Say it together

“H is for house. Hhh — house! This is a house.”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Letter sound

H is a breathy little sigh: hhh, like fogging a window. Breathe out warmly on your palm — hhh — and you have said the whole sound.

Try this

Play the h breath game: hold a tissue in front of your mouth and say hhh to make it dance. Then hhh-house, hhh-hat, hhh-hand around the room.

Quick parent note

H is invisible in fast speech — children hear “ouse” more than they hear the h. Exaggerate the breath on this card and it snaps back into place.

These cards come from the Alphabet & Letter Sounds for 3 Year Olds — the full interactive class with games, sounds and a print view.
